description: Candidate source inventory for the tiered CRMS corpus. Word counts are planning estimates, not measured holdings. No source is approved for packaging until its licence, attribution, and retrieval manifest are recorded.

core.purpose: Portable clean-room model with broad reference, book, code, math, science, documentation, Q&A, and translation exposure.

extended.purpose: Optional local corpus for a workstation; selected and licensed by the user.

research.purpose: Web-scale evaluation or research sources acquired under explicit licences and manifests.

licence_policy.share_alike_obligation: Preserve source attribution and licence notices; do not relicense the source text.
notes: Non-commercial and no-derivatives terms require explicit review before packaging.
Per-document manifests must record source URL, retrieval date, licence, revision or hash, attribution, and importer version.
Evaluation sets are built separately and are never ingested as training or retrieval sources.

sources.title: Simple English Wikipedia
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0
sources.estimate_basis: Planning slice of a SimpleWiki dump; exact article and word counts depend on the dump date.
sources.notes: Core reference backbone. Keep revision id, dump date, and attribution per document.

sources.title: Project Gutenberg selected public-domain books
sources.licence: Public domain in the United States
sources.estimate_basis: Target slice of 200-400 books; actual count depends on title selection.
sources.notes: Select titles with cleared US public-domain status and record the source edition.

sources.title: CRMS project source, docs, and experiments
sources.licence: MIT License
sources.estimate_basis: Local repository inventory; measured at build time.
sources.notes: Preserve the MIT notice and distinguish project-authored text from user-provided design notes.

sources.title: Curated local source notes
sources.licence: Mixed; each note carries a Source URL and page licence
sources.estimate_basis: Measured local corpus; grows as notes are added.
sources.notes: The build script rejects a curated note without a Source URL. Keep the page licence with each note.

sources.title: Python documentation
sources.licence: Python Software Foundation License Version 2
sources.estimate_basis: Selected language, library, and tutorial pages; exact slice depends on version.
sources.notes: Record the documentation version and preserve the PSF licence notice.

sources.title: IETF RFC text corpus
sources.licence: IETF Trust legal provisions; BSD-style reuse for many RFCs
sources.estimate_basis: Selected protocol and internet-standards RFCs.
sources.notes: Check per-RFC copyright and code-component terms; several RFCs have specific notices.

sources.title: OpenStax open textbooks
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (selected titles)
sources.estimate_basis: Selected algebra, calculus, physics, chemistry, and biology titles.
sources.notes: Verify the licence of each edition; some ancillaries use different terms.

sources.title: Tatoeba sentence pairs
sources.licence: CC BY 2.0 FR
sources.estimate_basis: Selected high-quality language pairs and short sentences.
sources.notes: Keep sentence ids, contributor attribution, and language tags.

sources.title: MDN Web Docs content and examples
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 2.5 for content; CC0 for code samples
sources.estimate_basis: Selected web-platform documentation pages.
sources.notes: Separate prose (share-alike) from code samples (CC0) if packaging.

sources.title: Stack Exchange Q&A
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 for post-2018 contributions; earlier posts may use earlier versions
sources.estimate_basis: Selected sites and high-score questions/answers.
sources.notes: Track per-post licence version and attribution; exclude deleted or personally identifying content.

sources.title: The Stack v2 permissive-code subset
sources.licence: Per-file repository licences; permissive subset only
sources.estimate_basis: Planning slice of MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD files after licence filtering.
sources.notes: Keep repository, path, commit, detected licence, and attribution; drop files with unknown or copyleft licences for core.

sources.title: arXiv metadata and abstracts
sources.licence: CC0 for arXiv metadata; abstracts and full text follow per-paper licences
sources.estimate_basis: Metadata and abstracts for selected categories.
sources.notes: Use metadata freely; check each paper before ingesting abstract or full text.

sources.title: PubMed Central Open Access subset
sources.licence: CC BY or CC0 per article in the OA subset
sources.estimate_basis: Selected biomedical OA articles; exact count depends on the subset and date.
sources.notes: Ingest only the OA subset; preserve article licence and attribution.

sources.title: English Wikipedia full dump
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0
sources.estimate_basis: Full dump scale; intended for local extended use, not the packaged core.
sources.notes: Use talk/page metadata carefully; exclude non-article namespaces from the core slice.

sources.title: Selected permissively licensed GitHub repositories
sources.licence: Per-repository licence; MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD only
sources.estimate_basis: Planning slice of vetted repositories.
sources.notes: Record commit hash, repository URL, licence file, and attribution; exclude vendored or generated code when possible.

sources.title: OPUS parallel text collections
sources.licence: Mixed per corpus; review each collection
sources.estimate_basis: Selected high-resource language pairs.
sources.notes: Do not ingest until each collection's licence is recorded and compatible.

sources.title: Project Gutenberg extended public-domain library
sources.licence: Public domain in the United States
sources.estimate_basis: Full-library scale estimate; intended for local extended use.
sources.notes: Filter by US public-domain status and record source edition.

sources.title: User-supplied books, documentation, and repositories
sources.licence: User-declared; must be recorded before ingestion
sources.estimate_basis: Variable; measured after the user supplies a manifest.
sources.notes: Require a per-document licence and redistribution decision.

sources.title: Common Crawl
sources.licence: Crawl terms and per-page terms vary; robots and opt-out must be respected
sources.estimate_basis: Research-only; no packaged slice planned in v0.
sources.notes: Not a core or extended source until page-level licensing and filtering are designed.

sources.title: arXiv full text for permissively licensed papers
sources.licence: Per-paper licence; only CC BY/CC0 or public-domain papers
sources.estimate_basis: Research-only until per-paper licence filtering is implemented.
sources.notes: Do not ingest the full corpus without a per-paper licence pass.

excluded.title: Books3
excluded.reason: No clear redistribution licence; contains copyrighted books.

excluded.title: The Pile
excluded.reason: Mixed-provenance collection with unclear per-component redistribution terms.

excluded.title: OpenWebText
excluded.reason: Web-derived text without per-document licence or attribution records.

excluded.title: OpenSubtitles
excluded.reason: Subtitle text has unclear redistribution terms for a packaged corpus.
